title: IVG Savr 3000 Fresh Menthol Mojito Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Fresh Menthol Mojito IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pods recreate the flavours of a chilled mojito cocktail with crisp Lime and refreshing Mint finished by cool Menthol. The result is a fresh, palate-cleansing vape ideal for hot days or everyday use. Each refill includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a 4ml refill reservoir. Once assembled, the system keeps the pod topped up as you vape — no refilling needed. Mesh coil technology ensures smooth vapour production, while the format is optimised for the IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pod Kit. How to Set Up IVG Savr Prefilled Pod's Step 1: Unpack the Device Remove the cap from the mouthpiece. Take out the silicone stopper from the pod. Step 2: Prepare the Refill Peel off the red sticker. Remove the rubber stop. Step 3: Connect the Pod Align the refill with the pod. Press until you hear a click. Step 4: Insert into Device Slide the full pod-and-refill unit into the Savr device. Step 5: Prime the Coil Wait a few minutes to let the coil fully saturate. ✅ Ready to Vape! Inhale to activate and enjoy.
